stories.title: Specialty chemicals startup altM raises $10.3 million
stories.summary: Specialty chemicals startup altM has raised $10.3 million in a Series A round led by Rainmatter and Mela Ventures. The company plans to use the capital to expand manufacturing capacity and accelerate the commercialisation of bio-based industrial chemicals. Existing investors also participated in the round.

stories.title: Bharat Semi raises $24 million for AI image sensors
stories.summary: Semiconductor startup Bharat Semi has raised $24 million in seed funding to develop AI-enabled image sensors. The company claims its programmable chips could cut system costs by at least 70 percent compared to conventional arrangements. Initial commercial production is targeted for 2027.

stories.title: Dreamteam raises $53 million for AI CRM platform
stories.summary: AI CRM startup Dreamteam has raised $53 million from Together Fund, Accel and Premji Invest. Founded in 2025 by former Freshworks executives, the company is building a platform designed to understand customer context and deploy AI coworkers to execute tasks. The CRM was supposed to be easier.

stories.title: Olyv extends Series B funding to $30 million
stories.summary: Credit-led fintech startup Olyv has raised $6 million from Nippon Life India AIF Management Limited, extending its total Series B funding to approximately $30 million. Founded in 2016, the company offers personal loans, gold savings and credit health management products.

stories.title: Xpressbees raises Rs 100 crore in debt
stories.summary: Logistics company Xpressbees has raised Rs 100 crore through non-convertible debentures from BlackSoil. The debt carries a 13.5 percent coupon over a 36-month term. The company will use the capital to fund its working capital needs.

stories.title: Bharat Semi Raises $24 Million in Seed Funding to Develop AI-Powered Image Sensors - Indian Startup Times
stories.summary: Indian semiconductor startup Bharat Semi has raised $24 million (approximately Rs 215 crore) in seed funding to advance the development of next-generation artificial intelligence-enabled image sensors for global markets. The New Delhi-based company plans to begin initial commercial production in 2027 and is exploring opportunities in the US and other

stories.title: Bharat Semi raises $24 million in funding to build AI sensors for robots, cameras and drones
stories.summary: Semiconductor startup Bharat Semi has raised $24 million in a seed funding round led by Info Edge, South Park Commons and Indus Bridge Ventures, to build image sensors that run AI on the chip itself. The round also saw participation from Micromax, Valour Capital, New York-based Gaingels and angel investors

stories.title: Dhruva Space raises Rs 147 crore in pre-Series B round
stories.summary: Dhruva Space is raising Rs 147 crore in a pre-Series B round led by IndusBridge Ventures. The funding follows a Rs 60 crore investment from the government-backed Antariksh Venture Capital Fund in July 2026. The company board has approved the issuance of compulsory convertible preference shares.

stories.title: Cybersecurity startup Corma reaches $1 billion valuation
stories.summary: AI cybersecurity startup Corma has raised $125 million at a $1 billion valuation, three months after emerging from stealth. The company offers AI agents trained for defensive security. Interest reportedly increased following recent vulnerabilities found in PHP and Node.js.

Vulnerabilities are just another kind of bug, and agents can now exploit what they find end to end. Defense is a different problem: it means digging through audit logs, security events and network flows,

stories.title: Dodai adds $3 million to Series A round
stories.summary: Ethiopian battery-swapping startup Dodai has extended its Series A funding to $16 million. The latest capital came from Tokyo Gas and a Singapore-based family office. The company operates a model where riders exchange depleted batteries for charged ones at dedicated stations.

stories.title: Numa raises $45 million for dealership AI
stories.summary: Oakland-based Numa has raised $45 million to build an AI operating system for car dealerships. The platform is designed to handle customer service, booking appointments and warranty paperwork by connecting directly to existing dealership software. The company aims to replace manual administrative tasks.

stories.title: Bedrock Energy raises $24 million for geothermal drilling
stories.summary: Bedrock Energy has raised $24 million to develop AI-directed geothermal drill rigs. The startup claims its technology can slash drilling times by up to 80 percent, reducing the costs associated with installing geothermal heat pumps. The ground remains a steady temperature year round.

stories.title: Ex-Tesla Autopilot trio raises $110M for simulation startup Zeromatter - Dealroom
Plural raises €1 billion for early-stage investments
stories.summary: VC firm Plural has raised €1 billion in new capital. Two-thirds of the fund is allocated to early-stage investments, while one-third is reserved for follow-on opportunities. The firm says it remains committed to backing early-stage moonshots that may require significant capital.

stories.title: Plural raises fresh €1bn fund to back ‘non-obvious companies’
stories.summary: Early-stage VC firm Plural has raised a new fund worth €1bn , one of the largest investment vehicles in the European tech ecosystem. News November 16, 2026 Plural raises fresh €1bn fund to back ‘non-obvious companies’ The firm's new fund is double the size of its 2024 vehicle 2 min

stories.title: India venture capital remains top-heavy
stories.summary: India-focused venture capital fundraising reached $5.4 billion in 2025, up from $2.7 billion in 2024. Much of this capital is concentrated in funds of $100 million or more, with 18 such rounds closed this year compared to four in 2024. Emerging managers are finding the environment challenging.

stories.title: Oister Global targets deeptech with new fund
stories.summary: Private markets manager Oister Global has launched a growth-stage deeptech fund with a target corpus of ₹600 crore. The fund, registered as a SEBI Category II AIF, intends to build a portfolio of 8-10 companies across sectors including spacetech, defence, semiconductors and quantum technology.

stories.title: Norwest closes $4 billion fund
stories.summary: US-based investment firm Norwest has closed a $4 billion fund to target opportunities in India, the US and Israel. In India, the firm plans to focus on value-added manufacturing, healthcare, artificial intelligence and deeptech. It typically invests between $30 million and $150 million in growth-stage companies.

stories.title: New funds prepare for launch after record haul
stories.summary: Indian private equity and venture capital firms raised a record $29.5 billion in the first ten months of 2026. Despite global uncertainty, a new wave of managers including 12Flags, Mettle Capital and Sauce VC are preparing to launch fresh funds to capture the ongoing momentum.

stories.title: Weekly venture capital funding hits yearly low
stories.summary: Venture capital funding into Indian startups dropped to $26 million across 11 deals during the second week of November. This marks the lowest weekly inflow for 2026, a decline attributed to the festive period and a lower volume of deals compared to the previous week's $263 million.

stories.title: Nexus partner Anup Gupta to depart
stories.summary: Anup Gupta, a partner at Nexus Venture Partners, will leave the firm in June 2027 after a 17-year tenure. His departure follows a string of senior-level exits at major Indian venture capital firms, occurring less than a year after Nexus raised its eighth fund.

stories.title: Ballistic Ventures seeks $490 million for cybersecurity
stories.summary: Ballistic Ventures is seeking to raise $490 million across two new funds to address demand for AI-driven cybersecurity. The firm filed documents with the SEC for a $360 million flagship fund and a $130 million investment vehicle. Neither fund has recorded capital sales yet.

stories.title: Report identifies influential private capital leaders
stories.summary: A new list identifies 100 individuals at the forefront of India's private capital ecosystem. The report highlights venture capital investors and family office leaders who are determining the flow of capital and innovation as they define the next phase of growth for the country's startups.

stories.title: Anup Gupta confirms Nexus departure
stories.summary: Nexus Venture Partners partner Anup Gupta has announced he will step down in June 2027. After 17 years with the firm, Gupta stated he is looking forward to passing on the baton within the team and exploring new opportunities in the startup ecosystem.

stories.title: Mahanadi Coalfields sets IPO price band
stories.summary: Mahanadi Coalfields has set a price band of ₹129-136 per share for its upcoming IPO, seeking a valuation of up to ₹90,000 crore. The offering is an offer for sale by parent Coal India, expected to raise ₹8,981 crore. Subscriptions open on 19 November.

stories.title: Meganet files for $78.6 million IPO
stories.summary: AI infrastructure provider Meganet Technologies has filed draft papers for an IPO to raise 7.4 billion rupees. The company, which counts data centers and brokerages among its clients, intends to use the capital to fund growth amid the ongoing artificial intelligence boom.

stories.title: Coal India to use IPO proceeds for diversification
stories.summary: Coal India is offering a 10% stake in subsidiary Mahanadi Coalfields to raise ₹8,981 crore. The parent company intends to use the proceeds to help finance a ₹1 trillion diversification programme covering coal gasification, renewable energy and critical minerals. The subsidiary will not receive new capital.

stories.title: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO grey market premium noted
stories.summary: State-owned Coal India is divesting a 10% stake in its subsidiary Mahanadi Coalfields through an IPO. The issue price band is set at ₹129-136 per share. Current grey market premium data suggests a potential 3.31% listing gain for investors participating in the offer for sale.

stories.title: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO valuation reaches $9.6 billion
stories.summary: Coal India subsidiary Mahanadi Coalfields has set its IPO price band at ₹129-136 per share. The listing values the coal producer at approximately $9.6 billion at the upper end of the band. Subscriptions for the offering are scheduled to open on 19 November.

stories.title: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO opens 19 November
stories.summary: Mahanadi Coalfields has fixed its IPO price band at ₹129-136 per equity share. The state-run subsidiary aims to raise ₹8,981 crore through the issue, which opens for subscription on 19 November. Investors can bid for a minimum of 110 shares.

stories.title: Perplexity considers 2027 IPO timeline
stories.summary: Perplexity CEO Aravind Srinivas said the AI startup could file for an IPO in the first quarter of 2027. The company previously aimed for a 2028 listing but moved the timeline forward after reporting annual recurring revenue of $1 billion, exceeding its $750 million target.

stories.title: Razorpay clears SEBI review for an India IPO reported at up to 6,000 crore rupees - MLQ.ai
Rediff.com files confidential IPO papers
stories.summary: Rediff.com India has filed confidential draft IPO papers with the Securities and Exchange Board of India. Reports estimate a potential fundraise of ₹600 crore to ₹800 crore, though the filing does not guarantee the company will proceed with a public listing.

stories.title: Lakshmi Venu seeks partition of TVS family assets
stories.summary: Lakshmi Venu has formally sought a partition of joint family assets belonging to a branch of the TVS family. The daughter of Chairman Emeritus Venu Srinivasan and TAFE Chairman Mallika Srinivasan has requested a fair and lawful division of the group holdings, citing her rights under succession law.

stories.title: Coimbatore robotics startup scales to Rs 8 crore
stories.summary: GOAT Robotics has grown from a rented 2BHK apartment to an Rs 8 crore business. Nine engineering graduates from Coimbatore pivoted from hotel robots to industrial automation, now spending Rs 40 lakh monthly on salaries. The company has expanded its robotic services to several countries.

stories.title: Lakshmi Venu issues partition notice to father
stories.summary: Lakshmi Venu has sent a formal partition notice to her father, Venu Srinivasan, requesting he discharge his fiduciary duties as head of the family. She asserts that under the Hindu Succession Act, she is entitled to a share of the joint family assets.

stories.title: Meesho CEO buys villa plots from Byju Raveendran’s family
stories.summary: Meesho CEO Vidit Aatrey purchased two luxury residential villa plots in Bengaluru for ₹83.81 crore. The sellers were Divya Gokulnath, wife of Byju Raveendran, and Deeptha Akhila Raghavan, wife of Riju Ravindran. The transactions were completed on 24 July 2026.

stories.title: Kunal Bahl on H-1B rejection and entrepreneurship
stories.summary: Kunal Bahl co-founded Snapdeal and Titan Capital after his H-1B visa petition was rejected while working at Microsoft. Rather than returning to India to work from the company's New Delhi office, Bahl chose to pursue entrepreneurship. Visa hurdles can be an effective career pivot.

stories.title: Elastic CEO claims context is the AI advantage
stories.summary: Elastic CEO Ash Kulkarni argued that business context is the primary advantage for enterprises as AI models become widely available. During the Elastic{ON} Mumbai event, the company focused on how businesses can leverage their internal data to make AI models useful for specific operations.

stories.title: TVS family dispute moves to legal partition
stories.summary: Lakshmi Venu has issued a legal notice to her father, Venu Srinivasan, and brother, Sudarshan Venu, seeking a partition of TVS Group assets. She alleges that beneficial interests have been concentrated in favor of her brother, excluding her own lawful rights. The matter is headed to court.

stories.title: Kunal Bahl reflects on H-1B rejection
stories.summary: Kunal Bahl, co-founder of AceVector Limited and Titan Capital, credits an H-1B visa rejection for fast-tracking his path to entrepreneurship. The 43-year-old now manages two public firms and serves as a judge on Shark Tank. Rejection can sometimes serve as a business strategy.

research.title: A Hybrid State Space-Attention Architecture for Forecasting the Trajectories of Battery Degradation
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Early-life battery degradation trajectory forecasting aims to predict a battery cell's full state-of-health (SOH) trajectory from its initial charge-discharge cycles, potentially reducing cell qualification and evaluation time from months to days. Despite recent advances, accurate forecasting. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Agent-Guided Process Verification for Mathematical Self-Correction
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models have made substantial progress in mathematical reasoning, yet in complex multi-step reasoning, an error at any step may propagate along an incorrect path, and the resulting solution may omit necessary branches. Existing natural-language. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Agents Cannot Hand Over What They Have Not Yet Understood
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Agents that work beyond a single context window, or in teams, hand their work to a successor as a short written summary. Evaluation has focused on whether an agent can solve a task, and relatively little. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Ask Precisely, Assume Wisely: Interactive Evaluation of Ambiguity Resolution in Large Language Models
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Ambiguity is a core challenge in human--AI interaction, where models must decide when to make assumptions and when to seek clarification. Existing approaches to ambiguity evaluation largely focus on coverage over multiple interpretations using static metrics. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Assume/Guarantee Contracts for the Compositional Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning of Heterogeneous Teams
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) problems for heterogeneous teams require agents to collaborate to complete team tasks while making the best use of diverse agent capabilities. We introduce assume/guarantee contracts for heterogeneous multi-agent systems (AGC-MAS) and Iterative. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Between Rigor and Reality: How AI Safety Benchmark Developers Understand Benchmark Use and Maintenance
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Safety benchmarks are cited as the primary tool to understand the risks posed by generative AI (GenAI) systems, yet growing evidence suggests they often fail to meet the needs of real-world safety evaluation. We present findings. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Bring Back Language to Actions: Restoring VLM capabilities in VLA Models via Parameter Merging
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) are obtained by fine-tuning pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on robot demonstration data, enabling action prediction from visual observations and language instructions. However, this fine-tuning induces catastrophic forgetting, substantially degrading the semantic and visual. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: CLEAR: Legible and Steerable Recommendation via Grounded Natural-Language Interests
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Modern recommenders keep learned preferences in representations people cannot inspect or change. We present CLEAR (Controllable and Legible End-to-end Architecture for Recommendation), an end-to-end system deployed at Meta and built around an editable natural-language interest layer. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
